purpose: Internet Archive manifest for Panasonic-origin post-footage pickup MOVs needed by the current RATTLE 1801 timeline.

derived_from.reason: These MOVs were referenced by the timeline but were not covered by the existing public footage/audio/misc archive buckets.

download.command: mkdir -p tmp/media && ia download rattle-postfootage-panasonic --destdir tmp/media --glob "00-SOURCE/postFootage/*" --source original && rsync -a tmp/media/rattle-postfootage-panasonic/00-SOURCE/postFootage/ 00-SOURCE/postFootage/
download.source_filter_note: Use Internet Archive originals only. Archive.org may generate playback derivatives that are not repository source media.

excluded_referenced_media.reason: Stock-style post footage. Do not redistribute through this archive item without a separate license review.

excluded_related_local_media.reason: Panasonic-origin local clip, but not referenced by the checked 1801-final-final-tweaks timeline export.

license_boundary: This manifest covers only shareable Panasonic-origin MOV files. It excludes licensed stock footage, licensed music, and third-party sound effects.
